title: Smoking prohibited.
bodyText: All public schools within the State, from kindergarten through grade twelve, shall prohibit the use of tobacco at public schools or at public school functions.
bodyHtml: §302A-102  Smoking prohibited.  All public schools within the State, from kindergarten through grade twelve, shall prohibit the use of tobacco at public schools or at public school functions. [L 2004, c 87, §2; am L 2014, c 232, §7]
